title: Reckoner configuration
description: User preferences and gate conditions for Reckoner. See docs/config-schema.md.

profile.description: Preset that seeds category defaults. Explicit fields override it.

learningMode.description: Global predict-then-reveal switch. Categories may override via 'inherit'.

ledgerPath.description: Local path to the competence ledger. Never leaves the machine.

skipBelowFrontier.description: Skip a gate when the concept is confidently below the user's frontier.

decayHalfLifeDays.description: Confidence decay half-life in days. null = never decays.

resolver.description: How intelligence is sourced and spent. Governs Tier 2 (spawned capsule) and Tier 3 (deep mode) only; Tiers 0-1 are always free.

maxSpawnsPerSession.description: Budget guard: max Tier-2 subagent spawns per session. 0 disables Tier 2 entirely.

profiles.description: Per-profile escalation policy. The active `profile` selects one.

maxPromptsPerAction.description: Cap on predict prompts raised by a single action.

escalate.description: When Tier 2 may run: always (learner) / only at a hard gate (builder) / never — provider not even retained (expert).

deepModeAllowed.description: Whether Tier-3 free-text + LLM grading may be enabled for this profile.

mode.description: off=never fires; observe=silent log; coach=teach then allow; gate=block until understood.

learningMode.description: Predict-then-reveal for this category. inherit = use global learningMode.
